+    gate = fixture.get("gate")
+    mutation = fixture.get("mutation")
+    require(isinstance(mutation, dict), "negative-control mutation must be an object")
+    violation = False
+    reason_code = ""
+    if gate == "official_origin":
+        reason_code = "THIRD_PARTY_MIRROR_NOT_OFFICIAL"
+        violation = not str(mutation.get("origin_uri", "")).startswith("https://www.cambridgeinternational.org/")
+    elif gate == "source_version_binding":
+        reason_code = "STALE_SOURCE_VERSION"
+        violation = mutation.get("expected_sha256") != mutation.get("observed_sha256")
+    elif gate == "continuation_conservation":
+        reason_code = "MISSING_CONTINUATION_PAGE"
+        violation = not set(mutation.get("continuation_refs", [])).issubset(mutation.get("page_chain", []))
+    elif gate == "paper_identity":
+        reason_code = "WRONG_PAPER_IDENTITY"
+        violation = not str(mutation.get("paper_instance_id", "")).endswith(str(mutation.get("printed_code", "")))
+    elif gate == "expected_set_exactness":
+        reason_code = "EXPECTED_SET_OMISSION"
+        violation = mutation.get("expected_ids") != mutation.get("observed_ids")
+    elif gate == "printed_marks_exactness":
+        reason_code = "PRINTED_MARKS_MISMATCH"
+        violation = mutation.get("expected_marks") != mutation.get("observed_marks")
+    elif gate == "source_alias_uniqueness":
+        reason_code = "DUPLICATE_SOURCE_ALIAS"
+        aliases = mutation.get("aliases", [])
+        violation = len(aliases) != len(set(aliases))
+    elif gate == "durable_path":
+        reason_code = "PATH_TRAVERSAL"
+        violation = ".." in Path(str(mutation.get("path", ""))).parts
+    elif gate == "durable_symlink":
+        reason_code = "SYMLINK_ESCAPE"
+        violation = mutation.get("is_symlink") is True
+    elif gate == "durable_binary":
+        reason_code = "MUTABLE_OR_MISSING_BINARY"
+        path = Path(str(mutation.get("path", "")))
+        violation = not path.is_file() or path.is_symlink()
+    elif gate == "expected_set_authority":
+        reason_code = "CANDIDATE_NOT_EXPECTED_SET_AUTHORITY"
+        violation = mutation.get("authority_status") != "accepted" and mutation.get("used_as_expected_set") is True
+    elif gate == "holdout_non_disclosure":
+        reason_code = "HOLDOUT_MEMBERSHIP_INFERENCE"
+        violation = mutation.get("actual_membership_included") is True \
+            or mutation.get("public_metadata_can_infer_membership") is True
+    else:
+        raise ValidationError(f"unknown negative-control gate: {gate}")
+    if violation:
+        raise NegativeControlRejection(reason_code)

+def scan_reserved_artifacts(values: list[dict[str, Any]]) -> None:
+    secret_patterns = (
+        re.compile(r"-----BEGIN [A-Z ]*PRIVATE KEY-----"),
+        re.compile(r"\bsk-[A-Za-z0-9_-]{20,}\b"),
+        re.compile(r"\bSUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY\b"),
+    )
+    forbidden_keys = {
+        "gold_value",
+        "gold_values",
+        "holdout_member_ids",
+        "selected_holdout_members",
+        "actual_holdout_membership",
+        "candidate_value",
+        "candidate_values",
+    }
+
+    def walk(value: Any) -> None:
+        if isinstance(value, dict):
+            require(not (set(value) & forbidden_keys), "secret/Gold/holdout material key finding")
+            for item in value.values():
+                walk(item)
+        elif isinstance(value, list):
+            for item in value:
+                walk(item)
+        elif isinstance(value, str):
+            require(not any(pattern.search(value) for pattern in secret_patterns),
+                    "secret/Gold/holdout material value finding")
+
+    for value in values:
+        walk(value)

+            f"maker observation binding mismatch: {object_id}")
+    require(paper["checker_observation_sha256"] == reviewer["observation_sha256"],
+            f"checker observation binding mismatch: {object_id}")
+    source = source_set["source_versions"][0]
+    require(source["source_version"] == f"sha256:{reviewer['source_bytes_sha256']}",
+            f"source version binding mismatch: {object_id}")
+    require(paper["full_document_page_count"] == reviewer["page_count"],
+            f"page-count mismatch: {object_id}")
+    questions = paper["questions"]
+    require([question["stable_question_id"] for question in questions] == reviewer["question_ids"],
+            f"question exact-set mismatch: {object_id}")
+    subparts = [part["stable_subpart_id"] for question in questions for part in question["expected_subparts"]]
+    require(subparts == reviewer["subpart_ids"], f"subpart exact-set mismatch: {object_id}")
+    printed = [[question["stable_question_id"], question["printed_total_marks"]] for question in questions]
+    chains = [[question["stable_question_id"], question["page_chain"]] for question in questions]
+    require(digest(printed) == reviewer["printed_marks_sha256"], f"printed marks mismatch: {object_id}")
+    require(digest(chains) == reviewer["page_chain_sha256"], f"page chain mismatch: {object_id}")
+    require(digest({"page_count": reviewer["page_count"], "questions": questions}) == paper["expected_set_sha256"],
+            f"expected-set immutable hash mismatch: {object_id}")
+    for question in questions:
+        chain = question["page_chain"]
+        require(chain and len(chain) == len(set(chain)), f"invalid page chain: {question['stable_question_id']}")
+        require(all(1 <= page <= reviewer["page_count"] for page in chain),
+                f"page chain leaves document: {question['stable_question_id']}")
+        require(set(question["continuation_refs"]).issubset(chain),
+                f"continuation missing from chain: {question['stable_question_id']}")

+        for part in question["expected_subparts"]:

+                    f"subpart anchor not conserved: {part['stable_subpart_id']}")
+            require(all(anchor["page_number"] in chain for anchor in part["anchors"]),
+                    f"subpart anchor leaves question page chain: {part['stable_subpart_id']}")
+            require(set(part["continuation_refs"]).issubset(chain)
+                    and not ({anchor["page_number"] for anchor in part["anchors"]} & set(part["continuation_refs"])),
+                    f"subpart continuation geometry invalid: {part['stable_subpart_id']}")
+    review_receipt = source_set["authority_review_receipt"]
+    require(review_receipt["receipt_sha256"] == receipt_digest(review_receipt),
+            f"authority review receipt hash mismatch: {object_id}")
+    if reviewer["authority_verdict"] == "accepted":
+        require(review_receipt["verdict"] == "accepted", f"accepted source lacks accepted review: {object_id}")
+        require(source["authority_status"] in {"official_verified", "official_reference_verified"},
+                f"accepted source has forbidden authority status: {object_id}")
+    else:
+        require(review_receipt["verdict"] == "quarantined" and source["authority_status"] == "quarantined",
+                f"authority conflict not terminally quarantined: {object_id}")

When validation runs with `--skip-durable-byte-readback` (the documented/tested path for environments without `/srv`), the validator only requires 157 unique hashes plus governed QPs and three paper-scope references, so replacing a supporting MS/threshold receipt with any other unique hash still passes. Compare the receipt hashes against the exact set implied by the authority bundle/review evidence (or a committed commitment) before the filesystem readback branch so skipped byte readback still catches missing supporting binaries.
